Deadrock and weathered deadrock are the natural rock of the Final Plateau and the highlands, and trollsteinn the natural rock of the troll caves, which no recipe makes; the rules leave all three out for having no stone word. Named one by one, only the blocks that census saw and judged, because a word a rule could read would take other mods' blocks with it, and because a file reaches a config that already holds detection's line where a changed rule does not. Cracked deadrock was not judged and is left to the rules, and the structure blocks are excluded.

The aurora block, the ice of the glacier, as named, ice, and the fluffy cloud, the floor of the cloud castles over the Highlands, cloud, the family Xep added for it (2026-11-11: Add both families), as 1.16.5's and 1.20.1's censuses ruled them, so the editions match (W4 R14, 2026-11-13); both are on a material no rule reads here. The aurora pillar and slab, auroralized glass and wispy cloud were not judged and are left to the rules.

A slab or stair takes its full block's ruling (Xep, 2026-11-13: Can we make it so all slabs of blocks that wear, also wear, in their own like the full blocks do? and: Same with stairs as slabs; W4 R15). These are this mod's slabs and stairs whose full blocks a census of 26.1.2 judged, each named at its full block's family so it wears on its own texture as the full block does. A slab or stair of a block the census excluded, or never judged, is left as it was.
